    from avkit_core.domain.conversion import REQUEUEABLE_CONVERSION_STATUSES

    from avkit_core.domain.enums import ConversionStatus, DownloadStatus

@pytest.mark.unit
def test_ac_115_1_failure_messages_skip_causes_and_safe_reason() -> None:
    transcript = importlib.import_module("avkit_core.domain.transcript")
    for name in (
        "TranscriptFailureCause",
        "TranscriptSkip",
        "failure_message",
        "safe_reason",
        "REASON_LIMIT",
    ):
        assert hasattr(transcript, name), f"avkit_core.domain.transcript has no {name}"
    from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError
    from enum import StrEnum

    from avkit_core.domain.errors import ValidationError

    cause = transcript.TranscriptFailureCause
    message = transcript.failure_message
    assert issubclass(cause, StrEnum)
    assert [member.value for member in cause] == ["blocked", "no_captions", "unavailable", "other"]
    assert message(cause.blocked) == (
        "YouTube is blocking caption requests from this network. "
        "Try again later or from another network, then Resume."
    )
    assert message(cause.no_captions) == "No captions for this video."
    assert message(cause.unavailable) == "This video is unavailable."
    assert message(cause.other, "the video is age-restricted") == (
        "Couldn't get captions: the video is age-restricted."
    )
    assert message(cause.other) == "Couldn't get captions."
    assert message(cause.other, None) == "Couldn't get captions."
    for allowed in (cause.no_captions, cause.unavailable):
        skip = transcript.TranscriptSkip(allowed)
        assert skip.cause is allowed
        assert skip == transcript.TranscriptSkip(allowed)
        with pytest.raises(FrozenInstanceError):
            skip.cause = cause.other  # type: ignore[misc]
    for refused in (cause.blocked, cause.other):
        with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
            transcript.TranscriptSkip(refused)
    safe = transcript.safe_reason
    assert transcript.REASON_LIMIT == 200
    assert safe("first line\nsecond line") == "first line"
    linked = "see https://example.invalid/a?token=SYNTHETIC_API_MARKER and http://x.invalid"
    assert safe(linked) == "see [link] and [link]"
    assert safe("x" * 500) == "x" * 200
    # The URL is replaced before the cut, so a cut never leaves part of a URL.
    assert safe("y" * 190 + " https://example.invalid/" + "z" * 50) == "y" * 190 + " [link]"

class DownloadYouTube(FakeYouTube):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.extract_calls = 0
        self.ids_calls = 0
        self.check_calls = 0
        self.playlist: PlaylistInfo | None = None
        self.video = VideoInfo(video_id="vid1", title="One", duration=1.0, formats=[])
        self.ids: list[str] = ["c1", "c2"]
        self.titles: dict[str, str] = {}
        self.channel: str | None = None
        self.delay = False
        self._release = __import__("threading").Event()
        self._entered = __import__("threading").Event()
        self.in_flight = 0
        self.max_in_flight = 0
        self.cookie_error: CookieTestError | None = None
        self.download_result = DownloadResult(
            file_path=Path("out.mp4"),
            file_size=12,
            video_id="vid1",
            title="One",
            sabr_detected=False,
        )
        self.service: DownloadService | None = None
        self.block_download = False
        self.download_entered = __import__("threading").Event()
        self.download_release = __import__("threading").Event()
        self.download_error: Exception | None = None
        self.last_options: object | None = None
        self.download_urls: list[str] = []

    def extract_info(
        self, url: str, flat: bool = False, options: object = None
    ) -> VideoInfo | PlaylistInfo:
        self.extract_calls += 1
        self.in_flight += 1
        self.max_in_flight = max(self.max_in_flight, self.in_flight)
        self._entered.set()
        try:
            if self.delay:
                self._release.wait(timeout=2)
            if self.playlist is not None:
                return self.playlist
            return self.video
        finally:
            self.in_flight -= 1

    def extract_video_ids(self, channel_url: str) -> object:
        from avkit_core.domain.download import ListedVideo, VideoListing

        self.ids_calls += 1
        self.in_flight += 1
        self.max_in_flight = max(self.max_in_flight, self.in_flight)
        try:
            if self.delay:
                self._release.wait(timeout=2)
            return VideoListing(
                tuple(ListedVideo(video_id, self.titles.get(video_id)) for video_id in self.ids),
                self.channel,
            )
        finally:
            self.in_flight -= 1

    def download(self, url: str, options: object) -> DownloadResult:
        self.download_urls.append(url)
        self.last_options = options
        self.download_entered.set()
        if self.block_download:
            self.download_release.wait(timeout=2)
        if self.service is not None and self.service.should_stop():
            from avkit_core.domain.errors import DownloadCancelledError

            raise DownloadCancelledError("cancelled")
        if self.download_error is not None:
            raise self.download_error
        if self.service is not None:
            self.service.on_download_progress(5, 10, 2.0)
        return self.download_result

    def check_sabr_status(self) -> SABRStatus:
        self.check_calls += 1
        return SABRStatus(
            mode=SABRMode.Active, source=SABRSource.Detected, checked_at=datetime.now(UTC)
        )

    def test_cookies(
        self,
        mode: str,
        browser: str | None,
        profile: str | None,
        cookie_file: Path | None,
    ) -> CookieTestResult:
        if self.cookie_error is not None:
            raise self.cookie_error
        return CookieTestResult(ok=True, error_message=None)

def _transcript_stack(
    tmp_path: Path,

    youtube: DownloadYouTube | None = None,
    coordinator: ExtractCoordinator | None = None,
    factory: SharedFakeFactory | None = None,
    clock: FakeClock | None = None,
    sleep: Callable[[float], None] | None = None,
):
    import inspect

    from avkit_core.services.transcript import TranscriptService

    uow = factory.uow if factory is not None else FakeUnitOfWork()
    factory = factory or SharedFakeFactory(uow)
    settings = SettingsService(factory)

    coord = coordinator or ExtractCoordinator(yt)

    captions = FakeCaptions()
    sleeps: list[float] = clock.sleeps if clock is not None else []
    extra: dict[str, object] = {}

        # The MEU-116 guards run before the service takes a clock; the required tests

        if "clock" in inspect.signature(TranscriptService).parameters:
            extra["clock"] = clock
    service = TranscriptService(
        factory,
        coordinator=coord,
        captions=captions,
        filesystem=filesystem,
        settings=settings,
        sleep=sleep or (clock.sleep if clock is not None else sleeps.append),
        **extra,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    )

class FakeTTSPort:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        from avkit_core.domain.enums import DeviceType
        from avkit_core.domain.tts import ModelStatus, VoiceConfig

        self.voices = [
            VoiceConfig(
                voice_id="am_eric",
                lang_code="a",
                language="en",
                gender="m",
                style_description="narration",
            )
        ]
        self.status = ModelStatus(
            variant_id="kokoro-pt-fp32",
            name="Kokoro",
            device="cpu",
            memory_bytes=1,
            is_loaded=True,
        )
        self.progress_values: list[float] = [0.25, 1.0]
        self.load_calls: list[object] = []
        self.unload_calls = 0
        self.generate_calls = 0
        self.service = None
        self.hold = False
        self.entered = __import__("threading").Event()
        self.release = __import__("threading").Event()
        self.in_flight = 0
        self.max_in_flight = 0
        # TA-4 (Session 35, MEU-75)
        self.devices: tuple[object, ...] = (DeviceType.Auto, DeviceType.CPU)
        self.device_calls: list[object] = []
        # TA-3 (Session 51, MEU-117): the formats whose runtime this fake build lacks.
        self.absent: set[object] = set()

    def load_model(self, variant: object, device: object) -> None:
        self.load_calls.append((variant, device))

    def unload_model(self) -> None:
        self.unload_calls += 1

    def generate(self, text: str, voice: object, speed: float, on_progress: object) -> object:
        import numpy as np

        self.in_flight += 1
        self.max_in_flight = max(self.max_in_flight, self.in_flight)
        self.entered.set()
        try:
            if self.hold:
                self.release.wait(timeout=2)
            self.generate_calls += 1
            self.last_text = text
            for value in self.progress_values:
                on_progress(value)
            return np.zeros(8, dtype=np.float32)
        finally:
            self.in_flight -= 1

    def list_voices(self) -> list[object]:
        return list(self.voices)

    def get_model_status(self) -> object:
        return self.status

    def available_devices(self, fmt: object) -> tuple[object, ...]:
        self.device_calls.append(fmt)
        return self.devices

    def runtime_present(self, fmt: object) -> bool:
        return fmt not in self.absent

def test_ac_12_7_immediate_return_fraction_and_lock(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    import threading

    _service, models, _tts, catalog, _fs, _media, _uow = _tts_stack(tmp_path)
    catalog.hold = True
    catalog.hold_after_progress = True
    returned = threading.Event()
    result: list[object] = []

    def _run() -> None:
        result.append(models.download("kokoro-pt-fp32"))
        returned.set()

    thread = threading.Thread(target=_run)
    thread.start()
    assert returned.wait(timeout=2)
    assert models.get_download_runtime().state == "Downloading"
    assert catalog.entered.wait(timeout=2)
    catalog.release.set()
    assert catalog.progressed.wait(timeout=2)
    assert models.get_download_runtime().fraction == 0.4
    catalog.release_after_progress.set()
    if models._thread is not None:
        models._thread.join(timeout=2)
    thread.join(timeout=2)
    assert models.get_download_runtime().state == "Idle"

    catalog.hold = True
    catalog.hold_after_progress = False
    catalog.entered.clear()
    catalog.release.clear()
    starters = threading.Barrier(2)
    inflight: list[str] = []

    def _contend(label: str) -> None:
        starters.wait()
        try:
            models.download("kokoro-pt-fp32")
            inflight.append(label + "-ok")
        except ConflictError:
            inflight.append(label + "-conflict")

    first = threading.Thread(target=_contend, args=("a",))
    second = threading.Thread(target=_contend, args=("b",))
    first.start()
    second.start()
    assert catalog.entered.wait(timeout=2)
    # download() returns while the catalog is held, so both contenders finish their call
    # before the held download is released; the later caller must see "Downloading" (A14).
    first.join(timeout=2)
    second.join(timeout=2)
    catalog.release.set()
    if models._thread is not None:
        models._thread.join(timeout=2)
    assert sum(1 for item in inflight if item.endswith("-conflict")) == 1
    assert catalog.max_in_flight == 1

def test_ac_115_10_secrets_reach_no_console_surface(
    tmp_path: Path, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]
) -> None:
    import json
    import re

    import structlog

    ansi = re.compile(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*m")
    rendered = re.compile(r"\S+ \S+ \[[a-z]+ *\] (?P<message>.*?) +seq=(?P<seq>\d+)")
    markers = (
        "SYNTHETIC_VIDEO_MARKER",
        "SYNTHETIC_COOKIE_MARKER",
        "SYNTHETIC_BEARER_MARKER",
        "SYNTHETIC_URL_MARKER",
        "SYNTHETIC_UNKEPT_MARKER",
        "SYNTHETIC_TRACE_MARKER",
    )
    health = _health(tmp_path, log_to_file=True)
    log = structlog.get_logger()
    log.error("probe.kept", video_id="vid-kept", detail="kept detail")
    assert _messages(health, "probe.kept") == ["probe.kept video_id=vid-kept detail=kept detail"]
    log.error(
        "probe.secret",
        video_id="avkit_token=SYNTHETIC_VIDEO_MARKER",
        error="cookie: SID=SYNTHETIC_COOKIE_MARKER",
        detail="Authorization: Bearer SYNTHETIC_BEARER_MARKER",
    )
    log.warning(
        "probe.url",
        detail="see https://example.invalid/caption?token=SYNTHETIC_URL_MARKER now",
        unkept="SYNTHETIC_UNKEPT_MARKER",
    )
    try:
        raise ValueError("SYNTHETIC_TRACE_MARKER")
    except ValueError:
        log.exception("probe.trace")
    ring = health.console_snapshot(0)
    stdout = capsys.readouterr().out
    filed = (tmp_path / "logs" / "console.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    surfaces = {"ring": " ".join(event.message for event in ring), "stdout": stdout, "file": filed}
    leaks = {
        name: [item for item in (*markers, "Traceback") if item in text]
        for name, text in surfaces.items()
    }
    assert leaks == {"ring": [], "stdout": [], "file": []}
    safe = {(event.message, event.seq) for event in ring}
    for raw in stdout.splitlines():
        line = ansi.sub("", raw)
        if line.startswith("{"):
            assert set(json.loads(line)) == {"seq", "message", "module", "level"}, line
            continue
        match = rendered.fullmatch(line)
        assert match is not None, line
        assert (match["message"], int(match["seq"])) in safe, line

def _race_stack(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    sleep: Callable[[float], None] | None = None,
):
    import threading

    service, settings, yt, uow, _fs, captions, _sleeps = _transcript_stack(tmp_path, sleep=sleep)
    _set_ids(yt, ["first", "second"])
    settings.set("transcript", "max_retries", 1)
    captions.retryable_left = 10**6
    workers = {"active": 0, "most": 0}
    guard = threading.Lock()
    original = service._worker

    def counted() -> None:
        with guard:
            workers["active"] += 1
            workers["most"] = max(workers["most"], workers["active"])
        try:
            original()
        finally:
            with guard:
                workers["active"] -= 1

    monkeypatch.setattr(service, "_worker", counted)
    return service, uow, captions, workers

    from structlog.testing import capture_logs

    from avkit_core.domain.enums import ModelFormat
    from avkit_core.domain.tts import MODEL_REASONS

    _service, models, tts_port, catalog, _fs, _media, _uow = _tts_stack(tmp_path)
    reason = MODEL_REASONS[ModelFormat.PyTorch]
    tts_port.absent = {ModelFormat.PyTorch}
    with capture_logs() as logs, pytest.raises(ConflictError) as raised:
        models.download("kokoro-pt-fp32")
    assert str(raised.value) == reason
    assert models.get_download_runtime().state == "Idle"
    assert models._thread is None
    assert not catalog.entered.is_set()
    assert [
        (entry["log_level"], entry.get("variant_id"), entry.get("detail"))
        for entry in logs
        if entry["event"] == "model.download_refused"
    ] == [("warning", "kokoro-pt-fp32", reason)]
    with pytest.raises(NotFoundError):
        models.download("kokoro-missing")

    # With the runtime present the download starts as today, and while it runs the in-flight
    # 409 comes before the build check.
    tts_port.absent = set()
    catalog.hold = True
    assert models.download("kokoro-pt-fp32").id == "kokoro-pt-fp32"
    assert models.get_download_runtime().state == "Downloading"
    assert catalog.entered.wait(timeout=2)
    tts_port.absent = {ModelFormat.PyTorch}
    try:
        with capture_logs() as busy_logs, pytest.raises(ConflictError) as busy:
            models.download("kokoro-pt-fp32")
    finally:
        catalog.release.set()
        if models._thread is not None:
            models._thread.join(timeout=2)
    assert str(busy.value) == "a model download is already in progress"
    assert [entry for entry in busy_logs if entry["event"] == "model.download_refused"] == []
    assert models.get_download_runtime().state == "Idle"

        {

            "downloaded_bytes": float("nan"),
            "total_bytes": 100,

            "status": "downloading",
            "downloaded_bytes": 1,

            "speed": 1.0,
        },
        {"status": "downloading", "downloaded_bytes": 2, "total_bytes": 100, "speed": 1.0},

        {"status": "downloading", "downloaded_bytes": 4, "total_bytes": 100, "speed": 3.0},
    ]

    monkeypatch.setattr("avkit_infra.youtube.adapter.time.monotonic", lambda: next(times))
    seen: list[tuple[int, int | None, float | None]] = []

class FakeDownload(_Lifecycle):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.jobs: list[DownloadJob] = []
        self.runtime = QueueRuntime("downloads", QueueProcessorState.Idle, None)
        self.sabr = SABRStatus(SABRMode.Inactive, None, None)
        self.start_calls = 0
        self.pause_calls = 0
        self.resume_calls = 0
        self.cancel_calls = 0
        self.check_calls = 0
        self.clear_queue_calls = 0
        self.archive_cleared = False
        self.cookie_error: CookieTestError | None = None
        self.last_cookie: tuple[object, ...] | None = None
        self.apply_updated = 2
        self.last_reorder: list[str] = []

    def get_queue(self) -> list[DownloadJob]:
        return list(self.jobs)

    def get_job(self, job_id: str) -> DownloadJob:
        for job in self.jobs:
            if job.id == job_id:
                return job
        raise NotFoundError(f"download job {job_id} not found")

    def get_processor_state(self) -> QueueRuntime:
        return self.runtime

    def get_sabr_status(self) -> SABRStatus:
        return self.sabr

    def add_to_queue(
        self,
        url: str,
        quality: QualityPreset,
        audio_only: bool,
        audio_format: AudioFormat,
    ) -> list[DownloadJob]:
        now = datetime(2026, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
        job = DownloadJob(
            id=str(uuid4()),
            url=url,
            video_id="vid1",
            title="One",
            quality=quality,
            audio_only=audio_only,
            audio_format=audio_format,
            status=DownloadStatus.Pending,
            progress=0.0,
            speed_bps=12300000.0,
            eta_seconds=125,
            file_size=1,
            file_path=None,
            error_message=None,
            queue_position=0,
            created_at=now,
            updated_at=now,
        )
        self.jobs.append(job)
        return [job]

    def start_processing(self) -> None:
        self.start_calls += 1

    def pause_processing(self) -> None:
        self.pause_calls += 1

    def resume_processing(self) -> None:
        self.resume_calls += 1
        if self.runtime.state is not QueueProcessorState.Paused:
            raise ConflictError("resume_processing requires Paused")

    def cancel_processing(self) -> None:
        self.cancel_calls += 1

    def remove_from_queue(self, job_id: str) -> None:
        self.get_job(job_id)
        self.jobs = [job for job in self.jobs if job.id != job_id]

    def clear_queue(self) -> None:
        self.clear_queue_calls += 1
        self.jobs = []

    def reorder_queue(self, job_ids: list[str]) -> None:
        by_id = {job.id: job for job in self.jobs}
        self.jobs = [by_id[job_id] for job_id in job_ids if job_id in by_id]
        self.last_reorder = list(job_ids)

    def reset_failed(self, job_id: str) -> DownloadJob:
        job = self.get_job(job_id)
        if job.status is not DownloadStatus.Failed:
            raise ConflictError("reset requires Failed")
        return job

    def check_sabr(self) -> SABRStatus:
        self.check_calls += 1
        self.sabr = SABRStatus(SABRMode.Active, SABRSource.Detected, datetime.now(UTC))
        return self.sabr

    def force_sabr(self) -> SABRStatus:
        self.sabr = SABRStatus(SABRMode.Active, SABRSource.Forced, datetime.now(UTC))
        return self.sabr

    def clear_sabr(self) -> SABRStatus:
        self.sabr = SABRStatus(SABRMode.Inactive, None, datetime.now(UTC))
        return self.sabr

    def apply_defaults_to_pending(self) -> int:
        return self.apply_updated

    def test_cookies(
        self,
        mode: str,
        browser: str | None,
        profile: str | None,
        cookie_file: Path | None,
    ) -> CookieTestResult:
        self.last_cookie = (mode, browser, profile, cookie_file)
        if self.cookie_error is not None:
            raise self.cookie_error
        return CookieTestResult(ok=True, error_message=None)

def test_ac_42_11_quality_blocked_jobs_carry_a_reason(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    from tests.e2e.real_stack import real_stack

    from avkit_core.domain.download import BLOCKER_REASONS

    assert BLOCKER_REASONS[DownloadStatus.QualityBlocked] == QUALITY_BLOCKED_REASON
    assert BLOCKER_REASONS[DownloadStatus.AgeRestricted] == AGE_RESTRICTED_REASON
    for token in ("SABR", "1080", "{"):
        assert token not in QUALITY_BLOCKED_REASON

    with real_stack(tmp_path / "avkit.db") as stack:
        stack.download.force_sabr()

        # Producer 1: enqueue under an Active lock.
        created = stack.download.add_to_queue(
            "https://youtu.be/dQw4w9wgGc",
            QualityPreset.P1080,
            False,
            AudioFormat.Default,
        )

        assert stack.listed_download(enqueued.id, AUTH)["error_message"] == QUALITY_BLOCKED_REASON

        # Producer 2: apply_lock over an already-Pending incompatible job.
        pending = stack.seed_download(DownloadStatus.Pending, quality=QualityPreset.P1080)
        stack.download.apply_lock()

def test_r1f1_stale_blocker_reason_is_canonicalized_at_the_boundary(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """A nonblank *noncanonical* blocker reason is stale, not sacred: canonicalize it.

    AC-42.12/42.14 only proved the *blank* legacy shape gets filled. A row whose
    reason names a quality it no longer carries (`insert_legacy_row` + Apply
    Defaults) kept its stale text, so the card showed "1080p unavailable" on a
    360p job.
    """
    from dataclasses import replace

    from tests.e2e.real_stack import real_stack

    with real_stack(tmp_path / "avkit.db") as stack:
        stack.download.force_sabr()

        # add(): a blocked job built with a stale reason is canonicalized on write.
        added = stack.seed_download(
            DownloadStatus.QualityBlocked, error_message=STALE_QUALITY_BLOCKED_REASON
        )
        assert stack.read_download(added.id).error_message == QUALITY_BLOCKED_REASON

        # save(): a stale reason written onto a still-blocked row is canonicalized.
        with stack.uow_factory() as uow:
            uow.downloads.save(
                replace(
                    stack.read_download(added.id),
                    error_message=STALE_QUALITY_BLOCKED_REASON,
                )
            )
            uow.commit()
        assert stack.read_download(added.id).error_message == QUALITY_BLOCKED_REASON

        # the refused Retry canonicalizes a stale reason, not only a blank one.
        refused_id = stack.insert_legacy_row(
            status=DownloadStatus.QualityBlocked,
            error_message=STALE_QUALITY_BLOCKED_REASON,
        )
        refused = stack.client.post(f"/api/v1/downloads/{refused_id}/reset", headers=AUTH)
        assert refused.status_code == 409
        assert stack.read_download(refused_id).status is DownloadStatus.QualityBlocked
        assert stack.read_download(refused_id).error_message == QUALITY_BLOCKED_REASON

        # Apply Defaults over a legacy stale row: the quality moves, the reason follows.
        stale = stack.insert_legacy_row(
            status=DownloadStatus.QualityBlocked,
            error_message=STALE_QUALITY_BLOCKED_REASON,
            quality=QualityPreset.P1080,
        )
        stack.settings.set("downloader", "quality", "360p")
        stack.download.apply_defaults_to_pending()
        after = stack.read_download(stale)
        assert after.status is DownloadStatus.QualityBlocked
        assert after.quality is QualityPreset.P360
        assert after.error_message == QUALITY_BLOCKED_REASON
        assert stack.listed_download(stale, AUTH)["error_message"] == QUALITY_BLOCKED_REASON

        # narrowness holds: a real failure message on a non-blocker row is untouched.
        failed = stack.seed_download(DownloadStatus.Failed, error_message="Traceback: boom")
        assert stack.read_download(failed.id).error_message == "Traceback: boom"

    # purity: the stale-reason branch replaces, and does not mutate its input.
    job = DownloadJob(
        id=str(uuid4()),
        url="https://youtu.be/dQw4w9wgGc",
        video_id="dQw4w9wgGc",
        title="Example",
        quality=QualityPreset.P360,
        audio_only=False,
        audio_format=AudioFormat.Default,
        status=DownloadStatus.QualityBlocked,
        progress=0.0,
        speed_bps=None,
        eta_seconds=None,
        file_size=None,
        file_path=None,
        error_message=STALE_QUALITY_BLOCKED_REASON,
        queue_position=0,
        created_at=datetime.now(UTC),
        updated_at=datetime.now(UTC),
    )
    from avkit_core.domain.download import normalize_blocker_reason

    assert normalize_blocker_reason(job).error_message == QUALITY_BLOCKED_REASON
    assert job.error_message == STALE_QUALITY_BLOCKED_REASON
